# INBUILD UK

> > INBUILD UK supplies professional fire safety, ventilation, and roofing products including EN54-certified CAST protocol fire alarms, Fakro roof windows, and mechanical ventilation systems.

INBUILD UK is a specialist distributor of building services equipment, focusing on fire detection and alarm systems (C-TEC, Hochiki), mechanical ventilation solutions (Elta), roof windows and flashings (Fakro), and smoke control products. Products are certified to British and European standards including EN54 series, LPCB, and comply with Building Regulations.

## Key Topics

- CAST protocol addressable fire systems
- EN54-certified fire safety equipment
- Fakro roof windows and flashing kits
- Mechanical ventilation (MEV) systems
- Fire and smoke dampers
- C-TEC fire alarm sounders
- Hochiki detection equipment
- Elta ventilation products
- LPCB certification
- Smoke ventilation control
- Fire detector testing equipment
- Weatherproof fire alarm devices
- Roof vents and rooflights
- Building Regulations compliance
- BSB damper systems

## Fire Detection & Alarm Systems

- [CAST Hi-Output Wall Sounder (shallow base) RED](https://www.inbuilduk.com/products/cast-hi-output-wall-sounder-shallow-base-red): C-TEC CAST Hi-Output Wall Sounder, EN54-3 certified, 100dB output
- [CAST Weatherproof Hi-Output Wall Sounder (deep base) (IP55) RED](https://www.inbuilduk.com/products/cast-weatherproof-hi-output-wall-sounder-deep-base-ip55-red): C-TEC weatherproof CAST sounder, EN54-3/17 certified, IP55 rated
- [CAST PRO CO Fire + Smoke + Heat Multisensor](https://www.inbuilduk.com/products/cast-pro-co-fire-smoke-heat-multisensor): CAST PRO CP411 multisensor, EN54-5/7/13/17/29/31 certified with MASC
- [Hochiki Dual Sounder Controller - DIN Enclosure with SCI](https://www.inbuilduk.com/products/hochiki-dual-sounder-controller-din-enclosure-with-sci): Hochiki CHQ-DSC2/DIN(SCI) dual sounder controller with fault monitoring
